budget_thresholds.budgeted_heavy_target_seconds: 60-90s using Codex 1 + Gemini 1 + Hermes merge, no post-review unless drift
budget_thresholds.post_review_gate: run one post reviewer only if Codex/Gemini disagree, STOP/HOLD_STOP_REVIEW appears, or reinsertion effect is unclear

fast_mode_use_when: small continuation from known safe lane
repeatability already passed and no new layer pressure
no fresh spatial ambiguity and no external agent insight needed
heavy_mode_use_when: user explicitly asks for actual Hermes/Codex/Gemini participation
task changes VectorFL operating principle or architecture
space interpretation is ambiguous across layers
drift/risk class appears: model-only merge, missing current-position, authority drift, hidden receipt failure, endpoint/API drift
promotion/authority pressure exists but must remain HOLD
fresh task requires cross-agent comparison not just artifact validation

operator_decision_table.mode: FAST unless previous next lane says heavy
operator_decision_table.signal: simple 계속 after PASS safe lane
too slow complaint plus process correction

post_review_decision.reason: SKIP_POST_REVIEW: Codex and Gemini both returned heavy/fast trigger structures; no STOP/HOLD_STOP_REVIEW conflict detected.

process_rule_for_hermes: Read actual space materials before deciding mode
If heavy mode: run Codex once for spatial anchors and Gemini once for layer pressure
Execute one concrete output and receipt
Reinsert as evidence only; never authority by default
purpose: Decide when Hermes should use heavy actual Codex/Gemini participation versus fast no-call/local validation.
